mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia increase digoxin toxicity risk by enhancing myocardial binding and reducing renal clearance of digoxin.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; maintain levels in normal range; monitor digoxin levels and signs of toxicity (arrhythmias, nausea); consider potassium-sparing agent or ACE inhibitor adjunctively.
